The '''Commerce Treaty of 1647''' was a legal covenant that assured the neutrality of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
{{Quote|How many times must I remind you of the Commerce Treaty of 1647? The Trade Federation is ''neutral''.|Lott Dod|<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />}}
The treaty assured the Trade Federation's official neutrality in conflicts and was invoked by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] during a debate in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] over the [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|Blockade of Pantora]]. According to the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] senator, he had invoked the same document on several occasions in the past, when confronted with rumors that the entire Federation was cooperating with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
